metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (Ruby controller) with deployable entry point (Rails 2.3 on Mongrel/EC2), MySQL database. Classified as application.
metadata.archetype_justification: MySQL database with CRUD operations (create/read orders), user-specific data, and entity lifecycle management.

findings.title: Undocumented REST API Interface
findings.description: The application exposes REST endpoints via a Rails 2.3 controller (GET /orders, POST /orders, GET /orders/:id), but these are entirely undocumented. No API documentation exists.
findings.gap: No API documentation. Integration requires reading source code.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.0 specification documenting all endpoints, request/response schemas, and error responses.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy model exists. No machine-readable API specification of any kind.
findings.gap: No machine-readable spec for automated tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the three endpoints.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No structured error responses. Controller renders HTML views on failure. No JSON error bodies, no error codes, no retryable indicators.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement consistent JSON error response format with error code, message, and retryable flag.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: POST /orders creates a new order and charges the card with no idempotency protection. No idempotency keys, no duplicate detection.
findings.gap: Agent retries would create duplicate orders and duplicate charges.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency key support (Idempotency-Key header) on write endpoints.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency keys on write endpoints.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: POST /orders creates orders and charges cards without idempotency protection. Write-enabled agents retrying on failure would create duplicate orders and charges.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add Idempotency-Key header support to POST /orders
blocker_remediation.target_state: All write endpoints enforce idempotency keys with duplicate response caching

findings.title: HTML Response Format Only
findings.description: Application returns HTML responses via Rails ERB rendering. No JSON serialization observed.
findings.gap: HTML responses are not machine-parseable by agents.
findings.recommendation: Add respond_to blocks returning JSON for API consumers.

findings.title: Synchronous Payment Processing Without Async Support
findings.description: Payment gateway call is synchronous with no timeout or async pattern. SOAP calls to legacy gateways can exceed 30 seconds.
findings.gap: Long-running payment operations may hit agent timeout limits.
findings.recommendation: Implement asynchronous payment processing with job queue and status polling.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, no SNS/EventBridge integration. State changes are not broadcast.
findings.gap: Agents cannot react proactively to state changes.
findings.recommendation: Add event emission for order lifecycle events.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented. No rate limit headers in responses. No API Gateway usage plans.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle.
findings.recommendation: Document rate limits and implement X-RateLimit headers.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: No authentication mechanism exists. Controller comments confirm no auth filters. No OAuth2, no API keys, no mTLS, no service accounts.
findings.gap: No machine identity. Any caller can access all endpoints without identification.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials flow with per-agent service accounts.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement API key authentication with principal attribution
blocker_remediation.target_state: OAuth2 client credentials flow with per-agent service accounts attributable in audit logs

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: No authorization model exists. No IAM policies, no role definitions. All callers have identical unrestricted access.
findings.gap: Cannot create scoped agent permissions.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based access control with at minimum read-only and read-write roles.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway with resource-level IAM policies
Implement reverse proxy with path-based access control

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. No ABAC, no fine-grained RBAC. Any caller can perform all operations.
findings.gap: Cannot restrict an agent to specific actions within a resource.
findings.recommendation: Implement before_filter authorization enforcing action-level permissions per principal.

compensating_controls: API Gateway method-level authorization
Network-level controls restricting write endpoints

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation. No JWT parsing, no OAuth token exchange, no user context headers.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT-based identity propagation supporting service-to-service and on-behalf-of-user flows.

compensating_controls: Limit agent to service-level operations only
Gateway-level header injection for user context

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Control
findings.description: Payment gateway credentials hardcoded in config/payment.yml committed to source control: merchant_id and api_password in plaintext.
findings.gap: Credentials exposed in repository. No secrets management or rotation.
findings.recommendation: Immediately rotate exposed credentials. Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.

compensating_controls: Immediately rotate exposed credentials
Move to environment variables as interim step

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging of any kind. Write operations are not logged with authenticated principal. No CloudTrail, no application audit trail.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated actions are undetectable and unattributable.
findings.recommendation: Implement immutable audit logging (CloudTrail + S3 Object Lock) with principal attribution for every write operation.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write operations (order creation, card charging) have no audit trail. Agent-initiated writes cannot be attributed or forensically investigated.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add application-level audit logging for all write operations
blocker_remediation.target_state: Immutable, tamper-evident audit trail with principal attribution for every write

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Capability
findings.description: No authentication surface exists (has_auth_surface is false). Identity suspension is not applicable at the application layer.
findings.gap: No identity lifecycle management. Suspension is a consumer responsibility.
findings.recommendation: Include revocation capability when implementing AUTH-Q1.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback for Multi-Step Operations
findings.description: Multi-step create+charge workflow has no compensation logic. If charge fails after order save, order remains in inconsistent state.
findings.gap: No rollback or compensation for partial failures in create+charge workflow.
findings.recommendation: Implement transactional boundary or saga pattern for the create+charge workflow.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND multi-step write workflow lacks compensation.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The create action saves an order then charges a card. If the charge fails, the order persists with no undo mechanism. Agent-initiated writes could leave data in partial, inconsistent states.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Wrap create+charge in a database transaction with rollback on charge failure
blocker_remediation.target_state: Saga pattern with explicit compensation endpoints

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no pessimistic locking, no ETags, no version fields. Multiple agent instances could create race conditions.
findings.gap: Concurrent write operations from multiple agents could corrupt order data.
findings.recommendation: Add optimistic locking via a version column on the orders table.

compensating_controls: Limit to single agent instance during pilot
Database-level unique constraints on order identifiers

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers for External Dependencies
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout on the external payment gateway call. Synchronous SOAP call with no failure handling.
findings.gap: Payment gateway outage cascades to all order creation requests.
findings.recommendation: Implement circuit breaker on payment gateway calls with timeout and exponential backoff.

compensating_controls: Connection timeout on payment gateway HTTP client
Health check detecting gateway unavailability

findings.title: No Rate Limiting or Throttling
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF, no application middleware. Endpoints directly exposed.
findings.gap: Runaway agent loops could overwhelm the application at machine speed.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with usage plans and per-caller rate limits.

compensating_controls: API Gateway or WAF with rate limiting
Apache mod_evasive for basic DDoS protection

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. No maximum orders per hour, no spend caps, no bulk operation limits.
findings.gap: Agent operations have unbounded business impact.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller transaction limits (max orders per hour, max spend per session).

compensating_controls: Per-caller daily order limits at gateway level
Maximum transaction amount check before charging

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state. Order creation immediately persists and charges the card with no intermediate reviewable state.
findings.gap: No reviewable intermediate state for human oversight of agent-initiated writes.
findings.recommendation: Add PENDING_REVIEW status to orders enabling human approval before card charging.

compensating_controls: Limit agent to read-only during initial pilot
External approval queue gating order creation

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval workflow mechanism. No configurable operation-level flags, no confirmation steps.
findings.gap: Cannot configure operations to require human approval.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates for high-risk operations.

compensating_controls: Step Functions with human approval tasks
Restrict agent to low-value operations only

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. No docker-compose, no environment-specific configurations, no seed data.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with production-equivalent data shape and docker-compose for local testing.

findings.title: Unscoped Sensitive Data in API Responses
findings.description: System stores PCI card data (card_number, card_exp). SELECT * returns all fields including card data in API responses. No field filtering, no access control differentiation.
findings.gap: Agent-facing responses include unmasked credit card numbers. No access control differentiation. No classification metadata.
findings.recommendation: Exclude sensitive fields from API responses. Implement separate scoped endpoints for payment operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fired — SELECT * returns card numbers in API responses.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The index action uses SELECT * FROM orders which returns card_number and card_exp in responses. Write-enabled agents consuming this endpoint receive unmasked PCI data.

b1.reasoning: SELECT * returns card_number and card_exp. No field exclusion, no response DTO, no serialization filtering.

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation. No OAuth scopes, no role-based access, no permission matrix.

b3.reasoning: No formal classification metadata, no field-level annotations, no PII detection tooling.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Replace SELECT * with explicit column selection excluding card_number and card_exp
blocker_remediation.target_state: Response DTOs excluding PCI fields; separate authorized endpoints for payment data

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls for PCI Data
findings.description: PCI-regulated card data with no residency controls or documentation. No mechanisms prevent cross-boundary data transmission.
findings.gap: No data residency controls for PCI-regulated card data.
findings.recommendation: Document residency requirements. Implement tokenization for card data. Prevent regulated data from leaving compliance boundaries.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND PCI card data has no residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system processes PCI-regulated card numbers with no residency enforcement. A write-enabled agent could transmit card data to an LLM in a non-compliant jurisdiction.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Document data residency requirements for PCI card data
blocker_remediation.target_state: Tokenization of card data with residency enforcement and documented compliance boundaries

findings.title: No Pagination or Result Limits
findings.description: GET /orders returns unbounded result sets. No pagination, no LIMIT, no cursor-based retrieval.
findings.gap: Agent queries could return thousands of records, exceeding LLM context windows.
findings.recommendation: Implement cursor-based pagination with configurable page size.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection and Mass Assignment
findings.description: No input validation. SQL injection via direct string interpolation. Mass assignment vulnerability (no attr_accessible). No parameterized queries.
findings.gap: Malformed or malicious inputs accepted without rejection. SQL injection allows arbitrary database access.
findings.recommendation: Fix SQL injection with parameterized queries. Add attr_accessible. Implement request validation.

findings.title: Partial Temporal Metadata, No Freshness Signaling
findings.description: Partial temporal metadata (created_at referenced) but no freshness signaling, no Cache-Control headers, no timezone normalization evidence.
findings.gap: No freshness indication to agents.
findings.recommendation: Add updated_at timestamps, normalize to UTC, include Last-Modified/Cache-Control headers.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction. Rails 2.3 default logging would expose card numbers in request parameters. No filter_parameter_logging, no masking.
findings.gap: Credit card numbers likely appear in application logs.
findings.recommendation: Implement parameter filtering for sensitive fields (card_number, card_exp, api_password).

compensating_controls: Add filter_parameter_logging for card fields
Implement log rotation with short retention

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics, profiling, or monitoring for MySQL order data.
findings.gap: Agents cannot detect data quality issues.
findings.recommendation: Implement basic data quality monitoring for the orders table.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, no API contracts, no breaking change detection, no changelog, no versioned URLs.
findings.gap: Agent tool bindings would break silently on any API change.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning and add breaking change detection.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer for the MySQL database. No AWS Glue, no documentation of schema semantics.
findings.gap: Building agent tools requires reverse-engineering the database schema.
findings.recommendation: Create a data dictionary documenting the orders table schema.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No distributed tracing (no X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry). No structured logging (no JSON, no correlation IDs). Rails 2.3 text logging only.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated request failures cannot be traced through the system.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry instrumentation and structured JSON logging with correlation IDs.

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No alerting thresholds configured. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no incident management integration.
findings.gap: System degradation goes undetected.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms on error rate and p95 latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual deployment via Capistrano 2 to fixed EC2 hosts. No Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.
findings.gap: Infrastructure not defined as code, not peer-reviewed, no drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure as Terraform or CloudFormation.

findings.title: No CI/CD or Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. No GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or CodeBuild. No automated testing in deployment.
findings.gap: API changes cannot be caught before agents are affected.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract testing.

findings.title: Rollback Capability Unverifiable
findings.description: Capistrano 2 has implicit rollback but no deployment configuration exists in the repository to confirm.
findings.gap: Rollback capability not verifiable from repository contents.
findings.recommendation: Add deployment configuration to repository. Implement automated rollback triggers.

findings.title: No Working Test Suite
findings.description: No working test suite. README states tests are stale and non-functional. No test files in repository.
findings.gap: No automated verification of API behavior.
findings.recommendation: Create integration test suite covering all endpoints.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest for MySQL 5.1 storing PCI card data. No KMS, no encrypted storage configuration.
findings.gap: PCI-regulated card data likely stored unencrypted at rest.
findings.recommendation: Enable encryption at rest via KMS or migrate to RDS with encryption.

evaluations.title: Queryable Current State
evaluations.reason: State is queryable via GET /orders (index) and GET /orders/:id (show). Agents can inspect current state before action.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority specified and no evidence of critical path designation.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names are semantically meaningful: status, created_at, card_number, card_exp, total. No legacy abbreviations observed.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry surface exists to assess — informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Focus on identity (AUTH-Q1), data scoping (DATA-Q1), audit logging (AUTH-Q6), and write safety (API-Q4, STATE-Q1).
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY findings and RISK-QUALITY improvements for engineering maturity, observability, and API quality.
Address INFO-level improvements and remaining quality items for full agent optimization.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity provider with machine identity support
recommended_actions.rationale: AUTH-Q1 is the foundational BLOCKER. All other auth controls depend on machine identity being established first.

recommended_actions.action: Implement PCI data tokenization and response scoping
recommended_actions.rationale: Card data exposure in API responses (DATA-Q1) and lack of residency controls (DATA-Q2) are compliance-critical BLOCKERs.

recommended_actions.action: Add idempotency and transactional integrity to write operations
recommended_actions.rationale: Write safety (idempotency, compensation, concurrency) prevents data corruption from agent retries and concurrent access.

recommended_actions.action: Implement immutable audit logging with principal attribution
recommended_actions.rationale: Audit logging is required for compliance and forensics of agent-initiated write operations.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy API Gateway with rate limiting and documentation
recommended_actions.rationale: Rate limiting and blast radius controls prevent agent traffic storms and unbounded operation impact.

recommended_actions.action: Create OpenAPI specification and structured error responses
recommended_actions.rationale: Machine-readable API documentation enables automated tool generation and proper error handling by agents.
